supporting_passages: Tension-based soil moisture sensors have been considered the best method to determine if a crop needs water since most vegetables experience reductions in yield and quality under prolonged periods of high soil water tensions.

Tension thresholds that optimize production have been determined for many vegetable species [17,19], including broccoli [20], cabbage [21], cauliflower [22], lettuce [23,24], potato [25], and tomato [26].
links.inference_note: The preceding sentence names tension-based soil moisture sensors as the method to avoid yield and quality losses, and the cited sentence states that tension thresholds measured by these sensors optimize production in named vegetables.
